meaning: A place to keep files on a company's computers. You reach them over the internet, so they are not only on your device.
clues: It's a place to keep your photos and files.
You can get to what's kept there from more than one device.
Your files are kept on computers that you reach through the internet.
A company usually runs it. It keeps your files on many computers.
Its name starts with T, and its second word is something you see in the sky.
assumes: A USB flash drive can be plugged into different computers
A memory card can move between a camera, a phone and a computer
A hard drive stores files in one computer and works without the internet

decoys.meaning: A device that stores a computer's files on one or more hard disks.
A small stick that plugs into a computer. You save files on it and carry them to another computer.
A small, flat card you put into a camera or phone to store data.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Your files can be saved there, so if you lose your phone you still have them.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: We kept spare copies of important papers in a second place. A spare copy kept somewhere else still holds.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Keep the account safe with a strong password and two-factor login. And if a message says you're out of storage, don't click its link. Contact the company using a number or website you know is real.

sources.name: FTC, how to protect your phone from hackers
FTC, are you really out of storage

blank.sentence: My photos live on a company's computers in ___, so I can open them from my phone or my laptop.

why: Your files are still there if you lose your phone, but guard the account.

situations.text: A text says your cloud storage is full and has a link. You contact the company through a website you already know instead.
situations.why: Use a number or website you know is real, not the link.
